src.title: 3 Mayonesas sin una gota de aceite (3 oil-free mayos)

recipes.title: Oil-Free Mayo (Egg & Yogurt) – Mayonesa sin aceite

items.i: salt and black pepper, to taste
splash of milk or water to loosen, if needed

steps: Add
Put the eggs and yogurt in a tall jug or immersion-blender cup.
Season
Add the mustard, lime juice, salt and pepper.
Blend
Blend with an immersion blender until thick and completely smooth, like mayonnaise.
Store
Transfer to a clean jar and refrigerate.
recipes.notes: Translated from Spanish (Cocina para Foráneos, Ecuador: '3 mayonesas sin una gota de aceite'). The post has no written recipe or measurements; ingredients are taken from the video and the amounts are estimated, so adjust to taste. As the creator says in the comments, without oil it's really a creamy yogurt-and-egg sauce in the style of mayonnaise. It keeps about 3 days in the fridge; extra lime or a splash of vinegar helps it last a little longer. Macros are estimates per 2 tbsp.

recipes.title: Green Avocado-Herb Mayo – Mayonesa verde sin aceite

items.i: large handful of cilantro and/or parsley
salt and black pepper, to taste

steps: Add
Put the avocado, yogurt and herbs in a tall jug.
Season
Add the garlic, lime juice, salt and pepper.
Blend
Blend with an immersion blender until smooth and bright green.
Store
Transfer to a jar, press plastic wrap onto the surface and refrigerate. It's best within 2–3 days; the lime slows browning but it will still darken.
recipes.notes: Translated from Spanish (Cocina para Foráneos, Ecuador: '3 mayonesas sin una gota de aceite'). The post has no written recipe or measurements; ingredients are taken from the video and the amounts are estimated, so adjust to taste. As the creator says in the comments, without oil it's really a creamy yogurt-and-egg sauce in the style of mayonnaise. In the video the green version is shown with onion rings for dipping.

recipes.title: Spicy Red Mayo – Mayonesa roja picante sin aceite
steps: Add
Put the eggs and yogurt in a tall jug or immersion-blender cup.
Season
Add the chili sauce, garlic and salt.
Blend
Blend with an immersion blender until thick and completely smooth, like mayonnaise.
Store
Transfer to a jar and refrigerate. A commenter's tip the creator liked: blend in a roasted red pepper.
